latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the DefiLlama Yields OpenAPI Skill.

- Enables read-only access to DefiLlama Yield APIs via UXC and a curated OpenAPI schema.
- Supports public yield pool discovery and per-pool chart history endpoints.
- No authentication required; all endpoints are public and read-only.
- Includes comprehensive guardrails and operational workflow for consistent usage.
- Excludes write operations and non-yield/Pro API endpoints.
